recycled_content.source_quote: PETg (including … 100% Thermoplastic PETg … 100% recycled PETg … polymer by weight … (post-industrial)
recycled_content.notes: Type set to unknown because sources conflict: the ISO 14021 declaration (March 2026) and PETg Sustainability Profile say post-industrial, while the rPETg TDS (Feb 2025) says 'Filamentive rPETg is made from recycled PET waste streams, such as plastic food containers and drinks bottles' (post-consumer). Self-declared ISO 14021 Type II; average of all colours.
